name: Exiv2
role: C++ CLI and library for editing EXIF, IPTC, XMP and ICC image metadata

summary: C++ library and command-line utility for inspecting, editing, deleting and copying common image metadata (EXIF, IPTC, XMP and ICC). It provides direct metadata operations without re-encoding image pixels.
use_when: Read, edit or strip image metadata in batch workflows
Choose metadata mutation over read-only media inspection
avoid_when: Use MediaInfo for broad audio/video technical metadata
Use C2PA tools for content credentials and provenance assertions
